name: Snickerdoodle Risks It All
source:
A new year begins, and Snickerdoodle’s heart is on the line. Four coin-flip choices determine if love blooms… or if she’s laughed out of the cafeteria forever.

[From [url=https://mareincognitum.itch.io/snickerdoodle-risks-it-all]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新的一年开始了，士力架的心也岌岌可危。四个抛硬币的选择决定了爱情是否会绽放……或者她是否会永远笑出自助餐厅。

[来自[url=https://mareincognitum.itch.io/snickerdoodle-risks-it-all]Itch.io[/url]]
